편집 중이던 핀 #{id} 이 목록에서 빠졌습니다(다른 쪽에서 닫았거나: Pin #{id}, which you were editing, left the list (closed or deleted elsewhere)
폭 맞춤: PDF 쪽 폭을 왼쪽 화면 폭에 맞춥니다 (Ctrl/⌘ 0): Fit width: fits the PDF page width to the left pane's width (Ctrl/⌘ 0)
핀 #{id} 검토 대기로 보냄 — 이 화면에 신원이 없어(로컬) 에이전: Pin #{id} sent to review — this screen has no identity (local), so it counts as closed by an agent
핀 #{id} 다시 열림 · 이유를 스레드에 남겼습니다: Pin #{id} reopened · the reason is in the thread
핀 #{id} 삭제됨 · 휴지통에 30일 보관: Pin #{id} deleted · kept in the Trash for 30 days
핀 #{id} 은 삭제되었습니다 — 누르면 휴지통에서 봅니다: Pin #{id} was deleted — click to see it in the Trash
핀 #{id} 은 이미 닫혀 범위를 바꿀 수 없습니다 — 메모만 고칠 수: Pin #{id} is already closed, so its range can't change — only the note can be edited
핀 #{id} 의 새 위치를 PDF에서 드래그하세요 · Esc 취소: Drag pin #{id}'s new location in the PDF · Esc to cancel
핀 #{id}{p} 같은 곳을 가리킵니다. 한 번에 고치고 함께 닫는 편: Points to the same place as pin #{id}. Better to fix them together and close both
핀 #{id}{p} 줄 범위가 일부 겹칩니다. 참고만 하고 따로 고쳐도: Partially overlaps pin #{id}'s line range. For reference only; they can be fixed separately
핀 다시 읽기·쪽 이동·확대·테마·닫힌 핀·삭제한 핀·도움말: Reload pins · go to page · zoom · theme · closed pins · deleted pins · help
핀 다시 읽기·쪽 이동·확대·테마·닫힌 핀·삭제한 핀·이 도움말: Reload pins · go to page · zoom · theme · closed pins · deleted pins · this help
핀 다시 읽기·쪽 이동·확대·테마·닫힌 핀·휴지통·도움말: Re-read pins · go to page · zoom · theme · closed pins · Trash · help
핀 다시 읽기·쪽 이동·확대·테마·닫힌 핀·휴지통·이 도움말: Re-read pins · go to page · zoom · theme · closed pins · Trash · this help
핀 목록 패널(좁은 화면에서는 아래 시트)을 펴고 접습니다. 카드를 누르: Expands and collapses the pin list panel (a bottom sheet on narrow screens). Tap a card to expand it
핀 목록과 선택한 자리 패널을 펴고 접습니다. 보라색 숫자는 검토 대기(: Expands and collapses the pin list and selected-spot panel. The purple number is the count of pins awaiting review (closed by an agent and waiting for a person's confirmation)
핀 범위 줄 자체는 바뀌지 않았고 바로 곁(±5줄)이 바뀌었습니다 — 가: The pin's range lines themselves didn't change, but nearby lines (±5) did — showing the nearest line
핀 파일을 다시 읽어 목록을 맞춥니다. 에이전트가 완료한 핀이 빠지고,: Reloads the pin file to refresh the list. Pins completed by an agent drop out, and line numbers shifted by manuscript edits are re-aligned. The PDF doesn't change.
The source location that will be saved with the pin. The agent opens these exact lines to make the edit. Click to copy
핀을 남길 때 쓴 메모를 펼치고 접습니다: Expands and collapses the note written when the pin was left
핀을 저장할 때 고릅니다. 질문 핀은 에이전트가 원고를 고치지 않고 스레: Chosen when saving a pin. For question pins, the agent doesn't edit the manuscript — it posts an answer to the thread and then closes the pin
핀을 찍은 첫 문장이 바뀌거나 지워져 위치를 되찾지 못했습니다. 이미 고: The first sentence captured when the pin was placed was changed or deleted, so the location couldn't be recovered. It may already be fixed — check, then mark it done, or use [Edit] → Relocate
핀을 찍을 때 떠 둔 첫·끝 문장. 원고가 고쳐지면 이것으로 새 줄 번호: The first and last sentences captured when the pin was placed. If the manuscript is edited, these are used to find the new line numbers
핀을 휴지통으로 보냅니다. 알림의 [되돌리기]나 휴지통에서 같은 번호 그: Moves the pin to the Trash. [Undo] in the notification or the Trash restores it under the same number (kept 30 days)
핀이 가리키는 원문 줄. 클릭하면 복사: The source lines the pin points to. Click to copy
한 줄씩 넓히고 좁히기: Widen and narrow one line at a time
. A dashed box ('New pin') is left.
화면 테마: 시스템 따름 → 밝게 → 어둡게 순으로 바뀝니다. PDF 종: Theme: cycles System → Light → Dark. The PDF's paper color stays the same
화면 테마: 지금 {name}. 누르면 시스템 따름 → 밝게 → 어둡게: Theme: currently {name}. Click to cycle System → Light → Dark. The PDF's paper color stays the same
휴지통에서 같은 번호로 되살립니다: Restore it from the Trash under the same number
휴지통에서 영구 삭제합니다(소유자만). 알림이 떠 있는 동안 [되돌리기]: Deletes it from the Trash for good (owner only). While the notification is up, [Undo] cancels it; it is deleted when the notification goes away
